data.content:
# Everton have found their fight

Patric Ridge

03/11/2026

In recent weeks, I — and many others — have bemoaned what seemed like a lack of desire from Everton.

Not a lack of effort, but a lack of a real want to go out and win football matches.

There was the complete no-show in the second half against Chelsea, which followed on from a 2-2 draw against Hull City in which Everton really should have kicked on and won after going 2-1 up, but instead they retreated into their shell. [...] News
